name: parry parkour
desc:
How to play:

On PC, press the F keybind to parry and get flung.
For Mobile, press the Parry button.
On console, press X to get flung.

Parry will work only if you get UNDER a part and immediately press the Parry button/keybind. It also works mid-air by double jumping to cancel your free fall.

towers from ETOH
